tools.name: search_disclosures
tools.description: Search receipt-linked US government financial disclosures: both chambers of Congress under the STOCK Act, plus executive-branch OGE filings (chamber 'executive', which holds the President's disclosures). Every row carries receipt.url, the government's own document for that row: a PDF page for House

tools.name: get_disclosure_history
tools.description: Observed versions of one disclosure within the caller’s filing window, oldest first. The change stream is append-only, so an amendment supersedes rather than overwrites. Both versions of a restatement may appear here, each with its own change block and receipt.url. restated=true means content change

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List filers with official identity (congressional filers carry their Bioguide ID; executive-branch filers return null with an explanation — identifiers are never invented). tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Live coverage counts (rows, filers, per-source totals) measured from the serving views at request time. The version field is the MCP connector release (1.22.0), not the REST API release.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read current source freshness, verified filing dates, export SHA-256 and Merkle root, temporal conformance and the point-in-time floor. When data is partial or unavailable, notices[].message explains the affected source or check. bulk_export.merkle_root is the day's commitment over every row's conte

tools.name: list_insiders
tools.description: Read SEC Form 4 transactions and filing receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/insiders. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.

tools.name: list_lobbying
tools.description: Read federal lobbying filings and LDA.gov receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/lobbying. Filings from commercial providers are excluded. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.

tools.name: list_stablecoin_reserves
tools.description: Read SEC reserve fund reports and their filing receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/stablecoins. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.
